seoTitle: Screenshot Device Framer (Phone, Tablet, Laptop, Browser Mockup)
metaDescription: Place a screenshot inside a generic phone, tablet, laptop or browser window frame on a plain or transparent background and download it as a PNG.
intro: Put a screenshot inside a phone, tablet, laptop or browser frame.
why:
Choose a screenshot and a frame style, set the colours and padding, and download a PNG. The frames are generic shapes drawn on a canvas, not copies of any real product. A soft shadow and a transparent background are optional.

The frame is drawn around your image at its full size, so nothing is cropped or resized.
howTo: Set frame colour, background and padding.
